name: network.luca/spr-mcp
title: SPR (Sealed Payment Record)
description: Seal every payment your AI agent makes as a signed record, on your own machine, with your key.

environmentVariables.name: SPR_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The agent's ID, such as agt_research

environmentVariables.name: SPR_ENTITY
environmentVariables.description: The company the agent pays for

environmentVariables.name: SPR_DIR
environmentVariables.description: The book's folder (default ./spr-books); it holds the company's private key

environmentVariables.name: SPR_TIME_ZONE
environmentVariables.description: The company's time zone for accounting dates (default UTC)

environmentVariables.name: SPR_BINDING
environmentVariables.description: on, to return the nonce to sign with each x402 intent
